Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment uses Proteomics of Isolated Chromatin fragments (PICh), which is a specialized form of affinity purification (AP-MS) using biotinylated DNA probes to capture chromatin-associated proteins. Acquisition on a Qexactive HF in a 'single-run' context typically implies DDA. Quantification is label-free based on intensities/NSAF.
